name: Matte, Satin, or Semi-Gloss: Choosing a Hardwood Floor Sheen
title-tag: Matte, Satin, or Semi-Gloss: Hardwood Floor Sheen Guide
meta-description: Matte, satin, or semi-gloss for your hardwood floors? A refinishing contractor on what each sheen hides, what it shows, and why durability isn't the question.
post-summary: September 18, 2026 · Sheen is the same finish reflecting different light — durability is identical. Why satin wins most floors, when matte and semi-gloss earn their place, and the $1.99/sq ft escape hatch if you change your mind.
